1b2(phal chen): sems dpa' kha cig 'di snyam du sems te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni ce tsam zhig tu bsam gyis mi khyab/sangs rgyas bcom ldan

2a2(phal chen): sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasarnams kyi chags pa myi mnga' ba'i rnam par spyod pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsal gyis myi khyab/sangs rgyas bcom ldang 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsang gyis myi khyab snyam pa dang /
2a3(phal chen): de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems thugs kyis thugs su chud nas/byang chub sems dpa' ut+pa la'i snying po/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du brlabs so//sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 
2a4(phal chen): kyis byin dang ldan par mdzad do//de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis snang bar mdzad do//sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis yongs su rgyas par mdzad do//sangs rgyas gyi myi 'jigs pa la rab tu gzhog go//sangs rgyas kyi 
2a5(phal chen): chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa khong du chud par mdzad do//sangs rgya kyi bdag nyid che ba nyid dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi yul rab tu rtogs par mdzad do//chags pa myed pa'i rgyud 'byam klas pa la rab tu gzhog gi//sangs rgyas thams cad 
2a6(phal chen): gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rigs rab tu rtogs par mdzad de//sangs rgyas kyi tshul gyi gnas brjod du med pa la rab tu gzhag pa mdzad do//de nas byang chub sems dpa' u t+pa la'i snying pos chos kyi dbyings la 'jug rig cing 
2b1(phal chen): khong du chud pas chags pa med pa'i dbyings su sgrub pa'i yid dang /chos thams cad la bsgribs pa med par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang ldan pa'i yang dag par 'jug pa dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 
2b2(phal chen): rjes su song ba'i sangs rgyas blta ba dang /snying rje chen pos lta ba'i sems can thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i go cha chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam dang /spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun chad pa myed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa

2b4(phal chen): 'di skad ces smras so//kye rgyal ba'i sras/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/tshad med pa la rnam par spyod pa ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras/sangs rgas bcom ldan 'das rnams na rnam par 'phrul pa chen po la rnam par spyod pa'o//kye rgyal ba'i sras 
2b5(phal chen): sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasarnams ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad la/sku'i mtshan thams cad rab tu brnyes pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das? rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba ni ting nge 'dzin dang /dgongs pas sbyar ba'o//
2b6(phal chen): sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'da' rnams kyi so so yang dag par rig ba bzhi ni brjod du med pa yang brjod du med pa shin tu bstan pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom? ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la bsam gyis mi khyab par rnam par spyod pa'o//sangs

3a2(phal chen): po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasarnams kyi chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams te/bcu gang zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasar rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku rnam par dag pa ni rnyog pa med par rgyud

3b1(phal chen): par spyod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dang rnam par 'phrul ba dang /cho 'phrul mi zad pa yang dag par ston pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag pa ni brjod du 
3b2(phal chen): med pa'i rgyan byin gyis brlabs pas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yang dag par bstan to//bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmyigs par mdzad pas mtha' dang dbus medapa'o//sangs rgyas bcom lda 'das rnams kyi 
3b3(phal chen): byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i khyad par dang /smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ni rnam par rol ba'i ye shes kyis chos yongs su rdzogs te/chos thams cad rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba la mtha' dang dbus med pa ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras 
3b4(phal chen): bcu po de dag ni/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so//kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 
3b5(phal chen): sangs rgyas kyi skad cig la ye shes kyi mngon par sgrub pa yang dag par bstan pa'o//bcu gang zhe na/skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jigs rten 
3b6(phal chen): gyi khams thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i tshe yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jig rtan gyi khams thams cad du mngon par 'byung ba yongs su bstan pa dang/skad cig gcig la 'jigarten gyi khams thams cad kyi byang chub kyi shing 
3b7(phal chen): drung du bzhugs shing mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su bstan pa dang/skad cig gcig la 'jigasten gyi khams thams cad duchos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yongs su bstan pa dag/skad cig gcig la 'jigaten gyi khams thams cad du'adul ba'i sems 
4a1(phal chen): @#//can yongs su smin pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du/dus la bab pa shes pas sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur ba yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul bzhin 
4a2(phal chen): du de bzhin gshegs pa brjod du med pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi sku sna tshogs rnam par dmigs pa yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jig rted gyi khams thams cad du/rgyan sna tshogs dang rgyan brjod du med pas/de bzhin 
4a3(phal chen): gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzod yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rtan gyi khams thams cad durnam par dag pa gcig ma yin pa thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang/skad cig   
4a4(phal chen): gcig la 'jig rten gyi kham sa thams cad du 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad du dbang po dang /brtson 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa byung ba dang /mos pa dang /spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa byung pa la dus gsum gyi

4a7(phal chen): sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das( )rnams kyi dge ba rnam par smin pa dang /rnam par ma smin pa mnyam pa nyid ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bar dus la bab pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldana'adas rnams kyis yongs su smin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams lung  
4b1(phal chen): bstan pa ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can gyi bsam pa'i rgyud du cho 'phrul yongs su bstan pa ni de'i dus las ma 'da' bas dus la bab ba yin/sangs rgyas bcom dan 'das rnams kyis

4b3(phal chen): rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasayul dang /grong dang /grong rdal du gshegs pa de ni de'i dus las mi 'da'o bas dus la bab pa yin//sangs rgyas bcom ldan dang rnams dad pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa tshul bzhin du sems can yongs su 'dzin pa ni/de'i

5a1(phal chen): @#//gzugs thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang /gnas gcig na bzhugs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par byon pa'i skur 'gyur pa dang /ye shes gcig rtogs pas chos thams cad la bsgribs pa

5a7(phal chen): mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye she sa dang /'jig rten gyi khams kyi yul ma skyes pa la 'jig rten gyi khams 'du ba dang /'jig pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang /yul thams cad mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la/las kyi rnam par smin pa mngon par bsgrub

21a2(phal chen): theg pa chen po yongs su rdzogs par bya bas kyang sems can rnams las phan 'dogs pa mdzad do//'gro ba thams cad gdon pas kyang sems can rnam la phan 'dogs pa mdzad de/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las
